name: Dara Holt
title: the Ditch-Mother
role: Senior east-channel irrigator of Millbrook, called the Ditch-Mother, and a member of Millbrook's elder panel
appearance: A composed woman standing at her own door before the frost has melted, a mug held in both hands.
voiceHints: Does her accounting fast and quiet, then waits. Will not say a theory aloud until someone else has confirmed it.
wants: The east channel running clean and on time, and the panel acting on the water before the water acts on Millbrook.
fears: Being the one who said it first and being wrong in front of the whole panel.
knowledge: Every sluice, sleeve and blank on Millbrook's east channel, and when each last failed

reactsToReputation.any: hears you out at her door and gives nothing away
reactsToReputation.reliable: tells you what she has not told the panel

questSeeds: The Ditch-Mother has seen the channel fail for weeks and has not yet said why to the panel
gear: a sluice key on a cord
_domainsWhy: growing things, the channel stones, and the sluices she keeps running
_levelWhy: §148: the tier is right (a ruling lord, a seated elder), so the level climbs to the tier's floor rather than the tier dropping.
